method: Median ENU error of libgnss++ RTK (low-cost preset, pin 62bd0b73) FIX epochs against reference.csv, pooled over Odaiba (n=5779) and Shinjuku (n=10193); calibrated = header - offset. Per-route medians agree within 0.035 m.
truth_use: One constant dataset calibration from the reference trajectory, approved 2026-10-03 and applied identically to every base-relative method. No per-epoch truth enters any estimator.
